Concluded separable: 'generate' means producing a NEW thumbnail/merged-image FROM the layer stack (pixel compositing + downscaling, requiring a rendering engine this package does not have), while 'replace' means accepting an ALREADY-PRODUCED new asset from a caller and swapping it into the archive after validating it -- a mechanical operation with no rendering dependency. Confirmed the underlying write mechanism already existed (OraImage.members is a general dict every dumps() call serializes, not limited to stack.xml), so only a validated, ergonomic, dedicated function was missing. Added replace_baseline_asset() reusing the exact same PNG-metadata-based constraint checks (satisfies_thumbnail_constraints/satisfies_merged_image_constraints) already proven for the read path, closing the loop between read-time and write-time validation with a single source of truth.

Returns a new OraImage via dataclasses.replace (added replace to the existing dataclasses import after checking for naming collisions -- found none, only str.replace() method calls elsewhere in the file).
